summary: Beasley Broadcast Group (via wholly owned sub Beasley Mezzanine Holdings) issued $98.5M aggregate principal of 10.000% Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Notes due 2027 in exchange for $184M of existing 9.200% Second Lien Notes due 2028. Holders received $500 of new notes per $1,000 of old notes plus 50% of accrued interest. Interest is PIK, payable semi-annually starting April 2027. The notes have a springing maturity of Sept 30, 2027 if no binding asset-sale or financing agreement is reached by then. This is a distressed exchange / liability management transaction, not a standard capital-raise; the deep discount and PIK feature indicate financial distress.
